task_source: director request: expand detector-disjoint holdout from 10 (v4) to 15-20 cases so Q3 moves from 'directional probe' to weakly confirmatory. Target 15 minimum.
detector: l1_relationship_verifier (B3 node forensics: duplicate / constant_offset / linear_transform), explicit_range_only=True, same protocol as v4.
method: For each new case: (1) download real source data from server pubpeer-archive to cases/<id>/artifacts/, compute sha256; (2) parse with openpyxl and verify the reported anomaly loci against the PubPeer/correction ground truth (NO synthetic data); (3) author case.json with 1 inconsistent + 2 clean claims anchored on real cell values; (4) run _validate_case (9-check official validator); (5) run B3 detector via the adapter exactly as the B1-B5 pipeline feeds it.
